HelpMessage:
You can create your own pokenjmin card using commands.
To set your card's data, use /set_card and fill the parameters as you wish.
Yo set your skills data, use /set_skill, chose one of your skills, and fill the parameters as you wish.
You can change any number of parameters in one go. Here's a map of what fields goes where on the final card: 
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1099874959876182047/1263170782415028366/PokenjminTuto.jpg?ex=669942f7&is=6697f177&hm=3415a90a8ce2818e33a8102cdff9c1e2eb19ec1a22b8359c3bf5c32e22d36d5d&=&format=webp&width=251&height=350

Every change made will send you a new preview that only you can see, we kindly ask that you don't share this preview publicly, to keep an element of surprise for everybody.
If you want to see your card's preview without changing anything, you can use the /preview command.
Your cohort number, card's background and specialty icon (top right corner) will be automaticly assigned by the bot using parameters set by your server's admin.

If you prefer to get the parameters of your card in a text format, type /get

You can reference a friend's card in your skills description, card description, or bottom text. To do it, ping your friend in the corresponding text. Please don't add any quotes or formating around the ping, as the bot will add its own formating, ensuring a consistent deck.

If you wish to reference a legendary card's name instead, type the command /list_legendaries, and it will list you all of the legendary cards and their corresponding "Insertion text", copy past this insertion text and it will act as if you "pinged" the legendary card.

The preferred ratio for the owner_image is 1:1, we recommend you use a resolution of at least 1080\*1080 pixels. 
The preferred ratio for the card_image is 1.48:1, we reccommend you use a resolution of at least 1080\*1523 pixels.
AdminHelpMessage:
If you see this second help message, it means you're an admin, congratulation !

You can modify other people cards using /switch_to_user_card, one you're switch, the /set_skill, /set_card and /preview commands will affect the other user's card. If you lose track of which card you're modifying, you can use the /get_current_switch command. You can reset your switch status with /reset_switch command.

You can create lengdary cards using /create_legendary, once your legendary is created, get its id using /list_legendaries and switch to it using the /switch_to_legendary command. You can then modify it same as another user's card.

You can also set things up for your server, like its cohort name and default specialty (useful if you're in a single specialty formation, like IEM or License) with /set_server_settings, if you're in a pluri-specialty formation, like Master JMIN, you can affect a specialty to different roles of your discord server, using /set_role_settings. These settings will fill fields of your server's members automaticly.
Congratulation for your rank and make good use of your powers !
